name: animated_explainer
summary: A narrated animated explainer or short built in code (Remotion, HyperFrames or canvas), shot by shot.
constraints: Follow the project's BRIEF.md: script, voice timing, style and banned tools.
Every shot renders on its own frame range and matches the voiceover timing.
Workers render stills of their shots (.deltaroute/render) and fix what they see before finishing.
brief_format: BRIEF.md: 1) one-line premise; 2) script with timestamps per shot; 3) style (palette, line, type, references); 4) characters and props with how they must read; 5) banned tools and assets; 6) output (resolution, fps, length).

acceptance: The shot renders without errors at its frame range.
Stills at the start, middle and end of the shot match the brief: subjects recognisable, text fully on screen, no overlap.
Motion timing matches the voiceover timestamps for the shot.

review_checklist: Consistent palette and line weight across shots
Cuts land on the voiceover beats
